error.message:
newspec-c: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap))
Known failure B24 (TFA-92579 AC 7-8, ready for QA), recorded on desktop Chromium, Pixel 7 Chromium and iPhone 15 WebKit. Tapping the Hospital card's trash icon opens the browser's native confirm() - 'Remove <name> from the rounding list? This will delete all notes, vitals, and encounter data for this patient.' - not an in-page dialog, so the focus / Escape-as-Cancel / layout checks of an in-page confirmation have nothing to run on (a native dialog cannot be screenshotted; its type and text are in the evidence). Cancel keeps the patient (list and server); OK deletes only that patient (server row gone, the neighbour stays). No 'deleted' message appears: no text and no status / alert / aria-live region within 4 s of OK on any profile (2 judged cells x 3 profiles failed). axe on the screen after the delete: color-contrast only. The Nursing Home list has no delete control at all (B24). Android half not run (emulator / device).
Product issue: Deleting a Hospital patient uses the browser's native confirm box instead of the app's own confirmation, and after OK the patient just disappears from the list with no 'deleted' message, on desktop and on phones; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all (B24).

testCase.name: [local] S28 The in-page delete confirmation and the deleted message: accessible, and fit on phone, WebKit and Android

descriptionHtml:
Bug B24 · P1 · known

Delete: Hospital uses the browser's native confirm and shows no 'deleted' toast; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC 7–8 ready for qa; TFA-94514 AC 1 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): no 'deleted' toast is AC 8; TC-24/S03 fails on the same evidence; Nursing Home has no trash icon and no screen calls snf.remove (TC-24/S05, dev U09).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S16, TC-01/S17, OAT-06/S22, TC-24/S03, TC-24/S05

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S28 The in-page delete confirmation and the deleted message: accessible, and fit on phone, WebKit and Android

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Deleting a patient asks for confirmation exactly once: tapping the card's trash icon opens a pop-up designed like the app UI that says what deleting does, with Cancel and OK; Cancel keeps everything. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-92579 AC 7; TFA-94699 AC 6)
  • T1 After a patient delete, an app-style confirmation message says "[Name]'s patient card was deleted". (TFA-92579 AC 8)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane (desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15 WebKit) and android-lane.ts, with the patient delete confirmation open and with the deleted message showing

When Run axe and the visual checks on both states

Then The confirmation is a dialog that takes focus, has Cancel and OK and closes on Escape as Cancel; the deleted message is announced (status / live region); both fit the screen with Cancel and OK visible and the message not hidden under the bottom bar; no WCAG 2 A/AA violations.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core violations = 0 plus the focus / Escape / live-region checks, on the two states only (visual-checks.ts).

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S28

The in-page delete confirmation and the deleted message: accessible, and fit on phone, WebKit and Android

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

Known failure B24 (TFA-92579 AC 7-8, ready for QA), recorded on desktop Chromium, Pixel 7 Chromium and iPhone 15 WebKit. Tapping the Hospital card's trash icon opens the browser's native confirm() - 'Remove <name> from the rounding list? This will delete all notes, vitals, and encounter data for this patient.' - not an in-page dialog, so the focus / Escape-as-Cancel / layout checks of an in-page confirmation have nothing to run on (a native dialog cannot be screenshotted; its type and text are in the evidence). Cancel keeps the patient (list and server); OK deletes only that patient (server row gone, the neighbour stays). No 'deleted' message appears: no text and no status / alert / aria-live region within 4 s of OK on any profile (2 judged cells x 3 profiles failed). axe on the screen after the delete: color-contrast only. The Nursing Home list has no delete control at all (B24). Android half not run (emulator / device).

Product issue: Deleting a Hospital patient uses the browser's native confirm box instead of the app's own confirmation, and after OK the patient just disappears from the list with no 'deleted' message, on desktop and on phones; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all (B24).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 12 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Needs android-lane.ts on the emulator besides the visual lane; iOS and Android are set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
